item.title: UP200 Silent Auction open through Sunday
item.description: The UP200 Silent Auction is now available through Sunday, February 15! Around 50 items are up for bidding this year, and can be viewed at the Marquette Holiday Inn, with 24-hour/day bidding exclusively taking place online on the UP200 website.

item.title: Inspired by ‘Walk for Peace’, People Welcome Texas Monks’ Journey to D.C.
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Walking 2,300 miles from Fort Worth, Texas to Washington, D.C., these Buddhist monks have captivated the nation. Their mission is simple: to advocate for peace. It’s a message that’s resonated across the country, especially here in D.C., where it’s the center of political discord.

item.title: Michigan budget proposal warns of tighter finances while protecting major programs
item.description: Michigan lawmakers are reviewing the first budget proposal for the upcoming fiscal year as state officials warn of shrinking federal support and rising costs. The recommendation maintains several major education and infrastructure programs while prioritizing health care and senior services.

item.title: Heated DOJ Oversight Hearing Focuses on Epstein Files, Redactions
item.description: It was a heated oversight hearing for the Justice Department and Attorney General Pam Bondi on Capitol Hill. Lawmakers pressed Bondi over delays in releasing the Epstein files and redactions within them.
